title: W021.5 Source Acquisition Register — Resumption R1
retrievalMethod: Web discovery plus repository connector review. A discovered page is not equivalent to a downloaded, hashed source artifact.

rules.hashPolicy: SHA-256 must be computed over exact downloaded bytes; never use a Git blob SHA as a file SHA-256.
rules.authorityPolicy: Government sources are primary only for the specific subject they publish. Community GIS is candidate/secondary data until reconciled to primary source.
rules.missingDataPolicy: Missing values remain NULL/UNKNOWN; no fabricated election result, geometry, PIN crosswalk, or financial disclosure.

limitations: Initial acquisition run returned HTTP 404 for guessed JavaScript URLs; direct retry with browser headers and pinned third-party GeoJSON candidates is in progress.
Election-cycle-specific geometry is not a universal 31-state current boundary release and must be checked for temporal/statutory applicability.
Focused probe 40212122850 returned HTTP 404 for all five /ac/{STATE_CODE}.js URLs; no raw official geometry was acquired.

All five direct ECI /ac/{STATE_CODE}.js URLs returned HTTP 404. Pinned third-party mirror GeoJSONs were acquired and audited; 824 features and AC_NO sequences match expected counts, but 23 raw geometries are invalid and 1,337 positive-area overlap pairs were detected after diagnostic make_valid. Not accepted for canonical geometry.
sources.plannedUse: Investigate portal-native geometry and provenance for the covered jurisdictions only.

lastProbe.conclusion: Do not repeat these exact URLs as a presumed source; investigate current ECI portal HTML/routes or request source from ECI/CEO custodians.

The first ECI direct downloads failed (HTTP 406/404); a retry with browser headers and pinned third-party ECI-portal-derived GeoJSON candidates is running. Do not claim these ECI geometry files downloaded until the second artifact manifest confirms it.

It is secondary, licence status is unconfirmed, and it does not close any external gate.

Retry workflow 40211792541 is currently in progress; no artifact has been published at last check. The prior completed run 40209022405 remains the only workflow artifact reviewed so far. Do not assume the retry succeeded.

Focused geometry probe run 40212122850 independently confirmed all five ECI .js URLs return 404 and the Telangana ArcGIS metadata endpoint is reachable. The initial f=geojson query was unsupported; corrected f=json query is queued in 40212257196. The probe ZIP SHA-256 was independently verified as e30baeff7c4ba94b0eee8d0e3fda41ddd7262a9880f7f4ac8e6ad9b9d7ce270e.

Telangana layer 24 geometry was acquired in run 40212257196 (119 features; SHA-256 91cd791317836d8a6a8729b03f08fd3aee8c727c82e123b1659972d949d32f27). Independent Shapely audit found one self-intersection in Dornakal (ST) Assembly; this candidate is not accepted. A second service EndowmentLands_Admin_2026/MapServer/12 is under probe in run 40212441232.

Broad source-acquisition run 40211792541 completed successfully: 31/61 source artifacts downloaded and hashed (142,219,649 source bytes), 24 failed. Five ECI-derived mirror GeoJSONs were acquired but rejected for canonical use after topology audit. Survey of India village boundaries were acquired for 14/27 jurisdictions, with 71,484 features, 37 invalid geometries, one CRS metadata conflict; they are not AC polygons or delivery-beat polygons.

Focused run 40212441232 acquired both the older Telangana Assembly Constituency Boundary layer and the EndowmentLands_Admin_2026 layer (119 features each). Both contain the same invalid Dornakal polygon and zero positive-area overlaps. Cross-layer comparison found 7 geometries differing above 0.01 m² and a maximum Hausdorff distance of about 3.04 km; neither layer can be selected without legal/source-owner adjudication.

Official ECI 2008 Delimitation Order PDF was read through the web PDF reader. Schedule III lists Andhra Pradesh Assembly constituencies and their territorial extents; a partial crosswalk for nine disputed/defective Telangana ACs is recorded in reports/evidence/w021_5_telangana_layer_comparison_2026-10-25.json. The PDF binary was not downloaded in this session, so no binary SHA-256 is claimed.

Additional official Telangana GIS service variants Admin_New layer 12 and Admin_Old layer 13 were discovered in the TGRAC service catalog and queued for comparison in run 40213242722. Do not choose among service names until geometry and legal effective-date evidence are reconciled.

The TGRAC Admin_New layer is byte-for-byte identical to the EndowmentLands_Admin_2026 layer (same 12,463,409-byte payload and SHA-256). Admin_Old is a distinct 12,461,961-byte payload; its 119-feature union has two disconnected components and one invalid Dornakal polygon. The official ECI 2008 PDF binary endpoint returned HTTP 406 (1,035-byte error body, SHA-256 7f512a...); web PDF text was reviewed, but no PDF binary hash is claimed.

Four Telangana GIS service variants are now acquired. Three EndowmentLands variants form one geometry family; the Admin_New and Admin_2026 payloads are byte-identical, while Admin_Old differs only at sub-millimetre coordinate precision. The older AdministrativeInfoSystem layer is the outlier with six material AC geometry shifts. Prefer the newer family for legal validation, not canonical import.

Enhanced ECI PDF retrieval used a persistent Chrome-impersonated session, homepage-cookie attempt, three URL variants and browser headers; all returned HTTP 406 with 1,035-byte HTML bodies. The legal PDF remains readable through the web PDF reader, but its binary bytes/hash are unavailable from this acquisition route.
